## IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) `[Quantum Computing]`
- IonQ announced development and testing of what it called the industry’s first end-to-end real-time quantum-error-correction decoder operating on a single standard, off-the-shelf CPU on September 22, 2026; the system performs error correction without slowing quantum operations (CNBC).
- IonQ said its Superion 256 quantum system will be installed at NVIDIA’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center alongside NVIDIA GPU clusters (The Motley Fool).
- IonQ’s announcement led Rigetti Computing, D-Wave Quantum, Quantum Computing Inc. and Infleqtion higher by more than 5.5% in premarket trading on September 23, 2026 (CNBC).

## Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`
- President Donald Trump said on September 23, 2026 that his administration was considering restrictions on diesel exports after U.S. diesel prices reached a record $6.529 per gallon on September 21, 2026 (TS2).
- U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the administration was assessing whether a full or partial diesel-export restriction was feasible; the White House later said a Reuters-cited report of a 90-day ban was “fake news” (Reuters, as reported by Investing.com).
- Jefferies analyst Lloyd Byrne downgraded Marathon Petroleum from Buy to Hold and set a $413 price target on September 21, 2026, citing valuation and the potential downside risk from diesel-export restrictions (Jefferies note).
- Marathon Petroleum and Valero Energy moved with the U.S. refining sector after the diesel-export discussion; Marathon was reported down 3% intraday before closing at the verified tape figure (Reuters).

## Valero Energy Corporation (VLO) `[Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]`

- U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the administration was assessing the feasibility of a full or partial diesel-export restriction; a White House official later told Reuters that a reported 90-day ban was “fake news” (Reuters, as reported by Investing.com).
- Jefferies analyst Lloyd Byrne downgraded Valero Energy from Buy to Hold and set a $401 price target on September 21, 2026 (Jefferies note).
- Valero and Marathon Petroleum moved with the refining sector after the diesel-export discussion; Valero was reported down more than 4% intraday before closing at the verified tape figure (Reuters).
